description:
Join us for a joyful celebration of colors and community @ Essência Aljezur! 🇮🇳🌹🇵🇹

Holi is an Indian festival celebrated around the Full Moon before the Spring Equinox. It marks the arrival of spring and the victory of light over darkness.

Inspired by this ancient tradition, we gather to release the old, welcome the new and celebrate love and connection.

✨ All Holi color powders are self-made, skin-friendly & fully organic! Please wear light clothes ready to get colored 🩵💜💛

Flow & Timing
3.00 Arrival, Chai & Connection
4.00 Opening, Grounding & Intention Setting
4.30 Krishna Kirtan & Puja
5.30 Holi Ecstatic & Color Blessings 
6.30 Holi Fire, Integration & Closing

Limited spaces available! Please secure your ticket in advance by scanning the QR code or following the link: www.anantaholistic.art/event/holi-ecstatic-celebration/

Curious? Check our vibe Instagram @anantaholistic or listen to the recording on Soundcloud: https://on.soundcloud.com/gVvneEQk0zv1Sqi7Do

We are looking forward! Happy Holi!
short_description: Join us for a joyful Holi celebration of color and community. Inspired by the ancient spring festival, we gather to release the old, welcome the new and celebrate love, light and connection. With music, ritual and vibrant organic colors, we honor renewal — and each other.
title: Holi - celebration of colors
